capabilities: Click links in Live Preview to place the cursor or select the link text
Apply to internal links, external links, or raw URLs
Reformat external link titles in Sentence or AP style
Apply title formatting to the current note or the whole vault
Bind formatting commands to hotkeys and configure behavior in settings
extras: The README warns that the third, optional formatting style "comes with a warning". The author asks for Ko-fi donations for future updates.
problem: In Live Preview, clicking a link activates it instead of letting you edit its text or address, and external link titles are often cased inconsistently.
summary: Link editing helper that changes click behavior for links in Live Preview and reformatting of external link titles in Sentence or AP style.
